# Real extracted text from https://www.wineshop-biarritz.fr/ -- the shop's
# own catalogue, an 84-page PDF of 1546 rows, captured by probe.py --capture
# (the whole thing is probe_pages/capture.www-wineshop-biarritz-fr.*.txt).
#
# Kept as a test fixture because this document is a different animal from
# purewijnen's ragged wine list: it is an inventory export, one row per
# reference, with the columns flattened into the row --
#
#     Nb | Nom | Famille | Sous Famille | Stock | Prix TTC Vente
#
# Everything the parser has to get right about it is in these lines: the
# stock column whose 0 means gone, the column header reprinted on every page,
# the "Page n sur 84" footer, and rows whose own label says which Ganevat
# line the bottle belongs to.
#
# Pages are separated by their real footer, so a test can rebuild the page
# structure the running-header rule needs.
